text_block_list.text:
Since Eishin Flash didn't seem to be in good shape,
I went with her to visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Wunderschön...
The air feels so pleasant.
I can sense a sacred atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the proper etiquette for praying at this shrine
is "two bows, two claps, one bow."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A 90-degree bow.
And I've prepared a pristine 5-yen coin, too.
choice_data_list: You really did your homework, huh?
You really did your homework, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing major.
There were just a few things I couldn't fully investigate...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How many seconds
should a bow take?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: How many seconds would be appropriate in this case?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The speed of the bow
and the duration of keeping one's head lowered are also unknown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If we don't know that, we can't pay our respects.
Whatever should we do...?
choice_data_list: A calm heart is more important than perfect etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A calm state of mind, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... Indeed, a tranquil heart
is essential for offering one's prayers.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'll give it a try.
(Clap, clap)
Eishin Flash offered her prayers with flawless etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Did I do it right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I was able to offer my prayers with a peaceful heart. I feel truly refreshed.

Eishin Flash's expression brightened.
It seemed her condition had improved as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Let's calm our minds first.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Calm down............

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I'd really like to make something clear, if I may...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"After all, how long should one spend
bowing in courtesy?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The time spent praying, the duration of ringing the bell...
I just can't stop fretting over it.

"Unable to visit the shrine to her satisfaction,
she walked home with slumped shoulders."
